dialogues.speaker: Hardy Two-Blades
dialogues.text: You're... about to go up against Lady Haniyyah, aren't you?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We're also feeling a little heavy about what happened with Haniyyah, so be careful of what you say next... We might get angry...

response.speaker: Hardy Two-Blades
response.text: I don't have the right to make any comments about you guys right now. It's just that... I saw the match between Lady Haniyyah and "Fried Tofu With All the Frills."

response.speaker: Hardy Two-Blades
response.text: I think something's changed inside Lady Haniyyah... This is the first time I've seen her like this. It's really quite... something.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph! Paimon has been wanting to say this to you. How could you have thought Haniyyah was a cold person? That's very disrespectful!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You've barely spoken to her, let alone understand her! For example, Paimon doesn't know you very well, but solely from your appearance, Paimon is going to assume that you're...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: An idiot who would get drunk and dance around the bonfire with your swords in your hands and a burnt mushroom kebab in your mouth, and trip over yourself before falling face down into a pile of mud!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then Paimon would go around telling everyone about it. Wouldn't you get mad if you knew about what Paimon was doing?

response.speaker: Hardy Two-Blades
response.text: Silver Companion! How... How did you know all that!?

response.speaker: Hardy Two-Blades
response.text: But you do make a point... It's true that I don't know how Lady Haniyyah is as a person... I may have caused her quite a bit of unnecessary trouble...

response.speaker: Hardy Two-Blades
response.text: I'm sorry, I shouldn't have commented on how Lady Haniyyah is as a person... I'm sorry!

choices.text: Wow, Paimon actually got to the big guy!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You may be overreacting a little... Paimon learned this from Miko and Layla!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyways, it's good that you know what you did wrong. Just make sure you don't do it again!

response.speaker: Hardy Two-Blades
response.text: See you... I need to reflect on this a little more...
